# Wayne Conrad Advisory

> Fixed-scope AI workflow sprints for service businesses of 5 to 50 people. Wayne Conrad Advisory is a remote-first company run by Wayne Conrad, who ran two service businesses for 28 years and built and sold both. Everything is built inside the client's own accounts and owned by the client.

## What is offered
- AI cleanup sprint: repairs failing automations, removes duplicate tool subscriptions, delivers a written map of live automations. From $1,500. Typical length 3 to 5 days, with 30 days of support.
- Single workflow sprint: one pipeline built and live (usually enquiry triage or client onboarding), approval steps, a recorded handover and a one-page runbook. From $2,900. Typical length 7 to 10 days, with 30 days of tuning.
- End-to-end ops engine: sales, delivery and finance connected, with an exceptions-only dashboard. From $8,500. Typical length 14 to 21 days, with 90 days of tuning.
- The final price is confirmed in writing before work starts.
- Free 15-minute workflow call and a free 2-minute diagnostic that shows which workflows to automate first.

## Facts
- Audience: owners of service businesses with 5 to 50 people.
- Method: fix the process, then automate it. Approval steps stay with people.
- Guarantee: written acceptance criteria before work starts; fixes at no charge for up to 10 working days from written notice; if still unmet, a refund of the fee paid for that sprint, as the only remedy for the work missing its criteria. Excludes problems caused by client changes, late access, incorrect data or third-party changes. Defects fixed during the support window.
- Not claimed: no guarantee of revenue, savings or hours saved; no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification held by Wayne Conrad Advisory.
- Data handling: an agreement is signed before data is shared; every tool that may handle client data is named in that agreement; business or API tiers only; minimum data; access is scoped and revocable; project copies are deleted when the support window ends, or earlier on request.
